title: Launch HN: Context.dev (YC S26) – API to get structured data from any website
summary: Context.dev is a YC S26-backed API service that extracts structured data from any website, returning clean Markdown, rendered HTML, screenshots, and images. It also provides company/brand context (name, logos, descriptions) when given a domain, making it easy to integrate web data into AI products and agents.
problem_solved: Eliminates the complexity of building and maintaining custom web scraping infrastructure for extracting structured data from websites.
why_valuable: Provides clean, ready-to-use structured data from any URL, saving developers significant time when building AI-powered applications and agents that need web content.
